items: Operations software brings scheduling, inventory, food costs, task management and compliance into one system, which makes a thin-margin business easier to manage.
If you run more than one site, choose a tool with a single dashboard that rolls up every location and lets you compare them side by side.
Look for automation of repetitive work, such as forecasts, prep lists and reorder alerts, plus integrations with your POS, payroll and accounting to avoid double entry.
Ease of use and real onboarding matter as much as features, because a tool your team never fully sets up delivers no value.
Momos adds guest feedback to the picture, surfacing review and message trends by location so managers know what to fix before issues spread.
